evidence: Cic. Verr. 2.1.26: lēx ampliandī facit potestātem (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A Roman court adjourned by pronouncing amplius, “more (hearing needed)”.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 193, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
